decisions.reason: Product A builds less on the firm's core waste-to-nutrient and engineering knowledge and falls outside its B2B industrial focus, limiting its ability to interpret and improve the drink mix.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions directly leverage the firm's existing engineering, prototyping, and waste conversion knowledge, supporting effective learning and improvement.
The waste oil to energy plant is a flagship focus closely tied to the firm's core R&D and waste-to-energy capabilities, giving strong absorptive capacity.
Plastic waste to fuel aligns with the firm's established waste conversion and energy competencies, allowing it to assimilate early results and refine the product.
